input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file describing the genomes to analyse.
input.help_text: A headerless CSV with one row per genome. Each row is either two columns (`name,ncbi_accession` or `name,fasta`) or three columns (`name,fasta,gff`). See `assets/schema_input.json` and the `data/` directory for examples.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

reference_and_download_options.title: Reference and download options
reference_and_download_options.description: Options controlling how reference genomes and annotation are obtained.

ensembl_biomart.description: Ensembl BioMart identifier used to download GO annotation.

ensembl_dataset.description: Ensembl BioMart dataset (species) used to download GO annotation.

predownloaded_fasta.description: Path to a pre-downloaded FASTA file, bypassing the download step.

predownloaded_gofiles.description: Path to pre-downloaded GO annotation files, bypassing the download step.

famdb.description: Optional Dfam famdb directory to override the one bundled in the Earl Grey container.
famdb.help_text: The Earl Grey container already ships a configured Dfam 3.7 database, so this is not required. To use a newer Dfam release, point this at a directory containing the famdb partitions (e.g. `dfam39_full.N.h5` files); it is bind-mounted into the container at `/opt/conda/share/RepeatMasker/Libraries/famdb`. Note that overriding only the famdb can cause version mismatches with the container's prebuilt RepeatMasker library.

analysis_options.title: Analysis options
analysis_options.description: Toggle which downstream analyses are run.

orthofinder.description: Run OrthoFinder to infer orthogroups across the input genomes.

earlgrey.description: Run Earl Grey for transposable element annotation.

hite.description: Run HiTE for transposable element detection.

execution_options.title: Execution options
execution_options.description: Options controlling how the pipeline executes.

forks.description: Maximum number of concurrent tasks (process.maxForks). Leave unset for no limit.

clean.description: Remove work directories when the pipeline completes successfully.

architecture.description: CPU architecture of the platform the pipeline is running on.

custom_config.description: Path to an additional Nextflow config file to include.

max_job_request_options.title: Max job request options
max_job_request_options.description: Set the top limit for requested resources for any single job.
max_job_request_options.help_text:
If you are running on a smaller system, a pipeline step requesting more resources than are available may cause the Nextflow to stop the run with an error. These options allow you to cap the maximum resources requested by any single job so that the pipeline will run on your system.

Note that you can not _increase_ the resources requested by any job using these options. For that you would need your own configuration file.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.
max_cpus.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the CPU requirement for each process. Should be an integer e.g. `--max_cpus 1`

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.
max_memory.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the memory requirement for each process. Should be a string in the format integer-unit e.g. `--max_memory '8.GB'`

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.
max_time.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the time requirement for each process. Should be a string in the format integer-unit e.g. `--max_time '2.h'`

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss format.

config_profile_description.description: Description of the institutional config profile.

config_profile_contact.description: Contact person for the institutional config profile.

config_profile_url.description: URL with documentation for the institutional config profile.
